text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oil and industry ministry issues 64 industrial licences worth 22 million dinars during the first half of 1997.
- British Airways says flights between Bahrain and London will be unaffected by its cabin crew strike.
- A Bangladeshi worker who suffered severe burns in an arson attack on a Sitra cold store on Saturday died from his injuries in a Bahraini hospital.
- Bahrain's Emir and his prime minister review chamber of commerce plans to boost the island's trade and economy.
- Big demand for gold on Bahrain's market as prices dip.
